A pond in a weekend

Posted by Sam

You do not need a digger to make a wildlife pond. A spade, a liner and a free weekend are enough, and the frogs arrive within a month.

What you need

  1. A flexible liner
  2. Sand or old carpet underneath
  3. Native plants for the edges

Put a sloping beach at one end so hedgehogs can climb out.
